name: ENISA (European Union Agency for Cybersecurity)
description: EU agency supporting member states with cybersecurity policy, certification, and capacity building. Backed by the EU Cybersecurity Act giving certifications legal standing.

peerReview.processDescription: European Cybersecurity Certification Framework under the Cybersecurity Act. European Vulnerability Database aggregated from national sources. Annual threat landscape reports with expert peer review. ECSF is peer-reviewed.

attribution.attributionNotes: ENISA-backed certifications recognized across all EU member states. EU Cybersecurity Act gives certifications legal standing.

povsAlignment.description: EU cybersecurity agency with legally backed certification framework.
